remarks:
Move-in ready! Explore the Winston, Marrano’s thoughtfully designed two-story townhome offering 2 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and a versatile second-floor loft ideal for a home office, hobby area, or additional living space. The first-floor primary suite provides everyday convenience, while a first-floor laundry room, guest powder room, attached 2-car garage, and full basement add functionality and storage options. Modern finishes include quartz countertops, soft-close maple cabinetry, luxury vinyl plank flooring, and neutral paint colors that complement a variety of styles.

Enjoy low-maintenance living with an association that takes care of grass cutting, snow removal, and landscaping bed maintenance, giving you more time to focus on what matters most. The community’s condo status may also offer real estate tax savings! Photos are of a similar home. For more information visit the model home at 20 Cloverleaf Ct. #1, Cheektowaga, NY, Saturday–Wednesday, 1–5 PM.
